import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250015;
    static long[] inv = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] p = new long[MAXN];

    static void init(int maxVal, long mod) {
        inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
        p[0] = p[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= maxVal; i++) {
            inv[i] = (mod - mod / i) * inv[(int)(mod % i)] % mod;
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= maxVal; i++) {
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        }
    }

    static long power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % mod;
            base = base * base % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        init((int) (n + 5), mod);

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(k, n, mod));
        } else {
            List<Integer> specialNums = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i += 2) {
                if ((i & n) == i) {
                    specialNums.add(i);
                }
            }

            int maxI = 20;
            long[][] dp = new long[maxI][(int) n + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < maxI; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
            }
            dp[0][(int) n] = 1;

            int limit = (int) Math.min(17, k);
            long totalAns = 0;

            for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
                long partialSum = 0;
                for (int val : specialNums) {
                    if (dp[i - 1][val] == 0) continue;
                    int mask = val & (val - 1);
                    int step = mask ^ val;
                    for (int v = step; v <= mask; v += step) {
                        if ((v & mask) == v) {
                            long valDp = dp[i - 1][val] * p[val] % mod * inv[v] % mod * inv[val - v] % mod;
                            dp[i][v] = (dp[i][v] + valDp) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                    partialSum = (partialSum + dp[i - 1][val]) % mod;
                }
                long invKMinusI = inv[(int) (k - i)];
                totalAns = (totalAns + partialSum * invKMinusI) % mod;
            }

            long finalResult = power(k, n, mod) - p[(int) k] * totalAns % mod;
            finalResult = (finalResult % mod + mod) % mod;
            System.out.println(finalResult);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
